keyVerseDR: "And God saw all the things that he had made, and they were very good." (Gn 1:31)

level1.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Creativity
level1.story: Creativity means thinking up new ideas and using them for good. God made the whole world, and He gave you an imagination too!
level1.keyLine: God made me to make good things.
level1.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice creativity all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: What new idea did someone in our family have this week?
How did our ideas help other people?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level1.prayer: Dear God, Creator of all, help me use my ideas to make good and beautiful things. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Draw a picture of something God made
TUE: Build something new with blocks or boxes
WED: Make up a kind song for your family
THU: Find a new way to help with a chore
FRI: Make a thank-you card for someone
SAT: Create a small prayer corner at home

level2.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Creativity
level2.story: Creativity is the gift of finding new and helpful ways to do things. God is the first Creator: He made the stars, the seas, and you. When we invent, draw, build, or solve a problem in a fresh way, and use that idea to help others or give glory to God, we share in His creative work. A creative idea is best when it is also a good idea.
level2.keyLine: God made me to make good things.
level2.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice creativity all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: What new idea did someone in our family have this week?
How did God help us grow in creativity?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level2.prayer: Dear God, Creator of all, help me use my ideas to make good and beautiful things. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Solve a family problem in a brand-new way
TUE: Design a card to cheer up someone sad
WED: Write a short story that teaches a virtue
THU: Reuse something old to make something useful
FRI: Plan a creative surprise for a family member
SAT: Make an art gift for Jesus or Mary
